name: calc_sum_mul_choose_sq
statement: (n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), k * (n + 1).choose k ^ 2 = (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1).choose n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), k * (n + 1).choose k ^ 2 = (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1).choose n
informal: ∑ₖ k·C(n+1,k)² = (n+1)·C(2n+1,n) — absorb k·C(n+1,k) = (n+1)·C(n,k−1), then Vandermonde ∑ C(n,k−1)C(n+1,n+1−k) = C(2n+1,n) (Nat.add_choose_eq).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), k * (n + 1).choose k ^ 2 = (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1).choose n
